title: Selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors in major depressive disorder
text: Selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors increase synaptic availability of serotonin by blocking its presynaptic reuptake transporter. They are considered first-line pharmacotherapy for major depressive disorder due to a favorable tolerability profile relative to older tricyclic antidepressants, although clinical benefit typically requires several weeks of continuous treatment.
